parts.text: 5. The Greatest Good Fortune

chunks.en_text: This is what I have heard . At one time the Blessed One was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. On that occasion, as the night was coming to an end, a certain god of great beauty approached the Blessed One while illuminating the whole Jeta Grove. After bowing to the Blessed One, they stood to one side and spoke a verse:

parts.text: This is what I have heard. At one time the Blessed One was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. On that occasion, as the night was coming to an end, a certain god of great beauty approached the Blessed One while illuminating the whole Jeta Grove. After bowing to the Blessed One, they stood to one side and spoke a verse:

chunks.en_text: “Many gods and humans, Desiring well-being, Are seekers of good fortune: Please tell me the greatest good fortune.”

parts.text: “Many gods and humans,
Desiring well-being,
Are seekers of good fortune:
Please tell me the greatest good fortune.”

chunks.en_text: “Not to associate with fools, But to associate with the wise, And to honour those worthy of honour: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “Not to associate with fools,
But to associate with the wise,
And to honour those worthy of honour:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “To live in a suitable place, Having previously done good karma, And to apply oneself in the right way: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “To live in a suitable place,
Having previously done good karma,
And to apply oneself in the right way:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “To be educated and to have a vocation, To be well-trained in one’s chosen field, And to speak words that are well-spoken: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “To be educated and to have a vocation,
To be well-trained in one’s chosen field,
And to speak words that are well-spoken:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “To support one’s mother and father, To cherish one’s partner and children, And to have a job without stress: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “To support one’s mother and father,
To cherish one’s partner and children,
And to have a job without stress:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “Generosity and an upright life, Kindness towards one’s relatives, And the doing of blameless deeds: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “Generosity and an upright life,
Kindness towards one’s relatives,
And the doing of blameless deeds:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “To refrain from what is unwholesome, To abstain from all intoxicants, And to be steadfast in good qualities, This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “To refrain from what is unwholesome,
To abstain from all intoxicants,
And to be steadfast in good qualities,
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “Respect and humility, Contentment and gratitude, And the timely hearing of Dharma: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “Respect and humility,
Contentment and gratitude,
And the timely hearing of Dharma:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “Being patient and easy to correct, The seeing of monks and nuns, And timely discussion on Dharma: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “Being patient and easy to correct,
The seeing of monks and nuns,
And timely discussion on Dharma:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “Asceticism and the spiritual life, Insight into the noble truths, And the seeing for oneself of Nirvana: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “Asceticism and the spiritual life,
Insight into the noble truths,
And the seeing for oneself of Nirvana:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “A mind that remains unshaken By the ups and the downs of the world, Sorrowless, stainless and safe: This is the greatest good fortune.

parts.text: “A mind that remains unshaken
By the ups and the downs of the world,
Sorrowless, stainless and safe:
This is the greatest good fortune.

chunks.en_text: “Having performed these things, Nowhere can they be conquered— They are secure wherever they go. This is their greatest good fortune.”

parts.text: “Having performed these things,
Nowhere can they be conquered—
They are secure wherever they go.
This is their greatest good fortune.”
